title: Core credit reaches QuickBooks as the exact negative amount
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a user with the Part sales -> Create & Edit permission, on the build under test. These are numeric/money-accuracy cases (Rule 116): seed the exact inputs, read the produced figure back and compare it to the cent - never eyeball.
  2. A customer to sell to exists; if none does, create one via Customers -> New Customer (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair").
  3. A post-release part sale with a $517.55 part carrying a $79.99 core, core charged. Seed it:
  4. ↳ Part Sales -> New Part Sale, select the customer (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair").
  5. ↳ Parts tab -> Add Part; Description "Water Pump", Sell Price $517.55; in the Core column enter Core Charge $79.99; save.
  6. ↳ Order and Receive the part so the core is charged.
  7. QuickBooks connected with the one-time consent given. Return the core, then Create Invoice and let it sync.
custom_steps:
1. In QuickBooks, open the synced invoice and read the Core credit line's unit price, amount, product/service, class and tax.
  2. Compare the QuickBooks amount to the document's -$79.99 Core credit row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Core credit is a negative invoice line with unit price and amount -$79.99, using the same product/service mapping, class and parts tax as the part row above it.
  • It is a negative line (not a credit memo), so it reduces the same revenue the part row increases; the QuickBooks amount equals the document's -$79.99 to the cent.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10262; Part Sales Update v1 PRD (Confluence 867434569), Story 1; design boards Document_*/Tax_* (exact figures shown on the canvas); read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R17: “a unit price and amount of -$79.99 on a $79.99 core, and the same parts tax treatment. It is a negative line on the invoice, not a QuickBooks credit memo, so it reduces the same revenue the part row increases”

Last checked against build v26.39.2-210868d on 10/1/2026.
